prompt: launch video for a note-taking app

plan.title: A Note-Taking App That Finds Your Ideas For You
plan.description: A launch video for a note-taking app that keeps every idea in one place and helps you find it fast. See how capture, search and sync remove the lost-note problem.

beats.narration: You had a great idea yesterday. Where is it now? Buried in a text, a sticky note, or a notebook you left at home.

props.text: Where did that great idea go?

beats.narration: Meet our new note-taking app. Capture your thought in whatever way suits you, and keep it safe.
Search helps you find your notes quickly. Your notes are always close at hand, wherever you go.
Stop losing ideas. Start keeping them. Download the app today and give every thought a home.
